//: Shared wire-protocol fixture — the single source both backends verify against.
TS side: tests/protocol-wire-parity.test.ts builds every message with Required<...>
(so a new optional field in src/protocol.ts breaks the compile until this file grows it)
and asserts encodeOutgoing / decodeIncoming match these entries.
Rust side: crates/aenternis-server/src/protocol.rs round-trips every entry through
ClientMessage / ServerControl and asserts lossless equality (serde silently ignores
unknown fields, so a knob missing on the Rust side fails the round-trip here).
Keep float-typed fields non-integral (1.5, not 1) so JSON number forms are unambiguous
on both sides. clientToServer mirrors MainToWorkerMsg; serverToClient mirrors the
JSON subset of WorkerToMainMsg (snapshot/cellDetail/metrics are binary frames, pinned
by the tests in native-client.test.ts and crates/aenternis-server/src/protocol.rs).
